# Stand Firm in the Fire
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who claims the name of Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. These aren't passive suggestions—they're commands issued to soldiers in enemy territory. The world, the flesh, and the devil are relentless, and passivity is surrender. But here's the tension: true strength isn't self-made. It's forged in dependence on God, not in pride. A man who tries to white-knuckle his faith alone will crumble. A man who watches, stands, and fights in the power of the Spirit becomes unshakable. Where are you being tempted to drift today? Where have you gone soft—in prayer, in purity, in honesty, in leadership at home? The call isn't to be flawless; it's to be faithful and vigilant. Strong men aren't those who never fall—they're those who refuse to stay down and keep their eyes fixed on Christ.
## Daily Challenge
Do 3 sets of 10 pushups. Between each set, pause and pray: "Lord, make me watchful and firm in the faith today."
